name: MCLEAN
recent: MClean Technologies 于11月完成2400万股私募配售，并在11月24日公布2026年第三季度业绩，营收2234万令吉。同期，公司披露涉及M&C Precision的诉讼，以及大股东Accrelist Crowdfunding Pte. Ltd.的股权变动。
notable: 完成私募配售，发行2400万股新股，发行价每股RM0.60，于11月11日上市。
公布2026年第三季度业绩，营收2234万令吉。
执行主席Datuk Dr Terence Teo Yeok Kian在公开市场及场外交易中增持及减持股份。
risks: 公司披露涉及M&C Precision的诉讼，对方已提交传讯令状。
大股东Accrelist Crowdfunding Pte. Ltd.在11月17日至18日通过场外交易减持合计3000万股。
私募配售发行2400万股新股，占扩大后股本约8.9%，可能摊薄现有股东权益。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收2011.7万令吉，环比增长8.9%，同比增长14.2%；净利385.9万令吉，环比增长21.1%，同比增长36.3%；净利率19.2%，高于上一季度的17.3%。

recent_en: MClean Technologies completed a private placement of 24 million shares in November and reported Q3 2026 revenue of RM22.34 million on 24 November. During the same period, the company disclosed litigation involving M&C Precision and changes in the shareholding of substantial shareholder Accrelist Crowdfunding Pte. Ltd.
notable_en: Completed a private placement of 24 million new shares at RM0.60 per share, listed on 11 November.
Announced Q3 2026 results with revenue of RM22.34 million.
Executive Chairman Datuk Dr Terence Teo Yeok Kian acquired and disposed of shares in open market and off-market transactions.
risks_en: The company disclosed litigation involving M&C Precision, with a writ of summons filed.
Substantial shareholder Accrelist Crowdfunding Pte. Ltd. disposed of a total of 30 million shares via off-market transactions on 17-18 November.
The private placement of 24 million new shares, representing approximately 8.9% of the enlarged share capital, may dilute existing shareholders.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM20.117 million, up 8.9% QoQ and 14.2% YoY; net profit was RM3.859 million, up 21.1% QoQ and 36.3% YoY; net margin was 19.2%, higher than 17.3% in the previous quarter.
